description: An English retelling that stays close to the original folktale, featuring a woman who tests a bear, a wolf, and a fox by their cattle-calls—only to learn too late that the fox’s sweet song hides a greedy trick.
tone: Wry, cautionary folktale with dark humor
summary: A woman hires a fox for his fine cattle-call, and he repays her by eating her herd and earning a white-tipped tail.
